ImageDescription.value:
Original listing and sheet music here: https://musescore.com/user/36482158/scores/11107603?from=youtube_share 
Flowery rag from the king of ragtime writers, Scott Joplin, published during his short time spent living in Chicago. Published by Will Rossiter in Chicago in 1905.

Original score source was from the Charles Templeton Sheet Music Collection at Mississippi State University at this link: https://scholarsjunction.msstate.edu/cht-sheet-music/2556/ This is a reproduction of the 1905 original score.

Hear Christina Pepper's excellent recital of "Eugenia": https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ITNc_Id19UU

Scott Joplin playlist is here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLWv_HHmWjvjXYOHNZK8ks1TcWqZeyHbmC

  1. ragtime #ragtimepiano #scottjoplin
